Your Spanish verbs note now has a flashcard page. Open the note and switch to **Page**. I haven't opened it on a phone myself.

- **Flipping:** Tap a card to flip it from the Spanish verb to the English meaning. All 12 verbs from your table are in.
- **Marking:** Tap **I know it** or **Again**.
- **Remembering:** Verbs you mark as known are saved with the date. The note's text itself isn't changed.
- **Order:** Cards you don't know yet come first. Once you know them all, it cycles through the full deck.
- **Extras:** There's a progress bar, an "All cards" list showing which ones are known, and a "Start over" button.

New verbs you add to the table will show up as cards automatically.
